label: date of birth
description: Player's birth date, written Mon DD, YYYY (e.g. Dec 27, 1981)

label: year of birth
description: Year in which the player was born (YYYY)

label: month of birth (Mon)
description: Month in which the player was born, as a three-letter abbreviation (Jan-Dec)

label: state of birth
description: State or province where the player was born: a two-letter postal code for US states, a region name elsewhere (e.g. La Romana); blank if unknown

label: city of birth
description: City where the player was born; blank if unknown

label: side of plate (R/L/B)
description: Player's batting hand, coded R (right), L (left) or B (both)

label: throwing hand (L/R)
description: Player's throwing hand, coded R (right) or L (left)

label: date of first appearance
description: Date of the player's first major league appearance (YYYY-MM-DD)

label: date of last appearance
description: Date of the player's last major league appearance (YYYY-MM-DD)

label: at bats
description: Average at bats per season; blank if the player has no recorded at bats

label: batting average
description: Career batting average (hits / at bats over all seasons); blank if the player has no recorded at bats

label: slugging percentage
description: Career slugging percentage (total bases / at bats over all seasons); blank if the player has no recorded at bats

label: salary
description: Average annual salary over the player's career, in US dollars (written $851,950)
